Vision & Mission

Vision

A future where accessibility and innovation converge

We envision a future where accessibility and innovation converge, empowering communities and businesses to improve their lives and environments with ease and confidence.

Vision for Mobility Solutions

Our goal is to become the leading mobility solutions provider in Southeast Asia and the Middle East. We aim to create products that transform transportation, ensuring it is seamless, safe and reliable.

Mission

Reliable, innovative and accessible mobility solutions

Our mission is to provide reliable, innovative and accessible mobility solutions that improve the daily experiences of individuals and businesses. We are committed to achieving engineering excellence, prioritising customer service and utilising forward thinking technology.

How We Deliver It

Engineering excellence on every installation, a service culture that answers quickly, and technology chosen for the next twenty years rather than the next twelve months.

02  ·  Detail

Vertical Transport for People

Passenger and home systems, where ride quality, finish and quiet operation are judged every day by the people who use them.

01

Passenger Elevators

Safe, smooth and efficient vertical transport for residential, commercial and public buildings. Specified around the building's traffic profile rather than a fixed catalogue, with cabin finishes selected to sit inside the architecture.

  • Machine room and machine room less configurations
  • Traction drive with 2:1 suspension
  • Rated load 450 to 2000 kg
  • Cabin finishes selected with the design team
02

Home Lifts

Crafted for private homes and smaller structures, convenience blended with luxury. Compact shafts and quiet drives allow a lift to be added to an existing residence with minimal structural disruption.

  • Compact footprint for existing homes
  • Quiet operation for living spaces
  • Glass and panoramic cabin options
  • Accessibility for multi generation households

03  ·  Products & Services Maintenance Programme
04  ·  Uptime

Maintenance Programme

Prevention is better than repair. Our maintenance philosophy keeps systems running and downtime near zero.

Scheduled Inspection

Planned visits on a fixed cycle, with mechanical, electrical and safety gear checked against a written schedule rather than by memory.

Condition Reporting

Findings written up after every visit, so building owners see the state of the asset and can budget replacement rather than absorb a surprise.

Planned Parts Replacement

Wear components changed on schedule, before failure. Genuine parts sourced through our Stade partnership.

Rapid Response

Three operating bases keep an engineer within reach when a call comes in, with entrapment calls treated as the first priority.

Outcome for the building owner

Downtime designed out, not managed after the fact

A lift that stops without warning costs far more than the part that failed. It costs tenant goodwill, it costs the building manager a day, and in a high rise it costs accessibility for the people who need it most.

06  ·  Achievements & Certifications Safety & Compliance
03  ·  Compliance

Safety & Compliance

Safety is not a department at ALTIGO. It is the constraint every other decision is designed around.

01

DOSH Registration and Inspection

Every installation is registered and inspected under Malaysia's Department of Occupational Safety and Health, and we hold the certification required to supply, install and maintain.

02

European Design Standards

Our supplied passenger lift platform conforms to EN 81-20:2020 and EN 81-50:2020, examined under the European Lift Directive 2014/33/EU.

03

Certified Installation Teams

Installation and servicing are carried out by our own certified technicians, not subcontracted labour, so responsibility never moves off our team.

04

Documented Testing and Handover

Performance and safety testing is completed and recorded before a system is handed over as fully operational.

Standing commitment

Upholding every safety regulation remains our highest priority

Regular safety workshops and on site assessments keep our teams aligned with DOSH standards, and every system we design and install is held to the strictest safety benchmarks.

DOSH Certified EN 81-20:2020 EN 81-50:2020 Directive 2014/33/EU

06  ·  Achievements & Certifications EU Type Examination Certificate
04  ·  Certification

Certified to the European Lift Directive 2014/33/EU

The TIGO-R passenger lift platform supplied by ALTIGO has undergone EU Type Examination by EUROCERT S.A., an accredited European Notified Body (No. 1128), certified to the latest EN 81-20 and EN 81-50 safety standards.

01

Independently Examined

Assessed by a third party notified body, not a self declaration of conformity.

02

Module B Approval

Full EU Type Examination under Directive 2014/33/EU, Annex IV.

03

Latest EN 81 Standards

Conforms to EN 81-20:2020 and EN 81-50:2020 for passenger lifts.

04

CE Conformity Pathway

Establishes the basis for CE marking upon final inspection and installation.

Issuing body EUROCERT S.A.  ·  Notified Body No. 1128 EU Type Examination Certificate for traction drive passenger lift, issued under the European Lift Directive 2014/33/EU.

06  ·  Achievements & Certifications Certified Performance Range
05  ·  Specification

Certified Performance Range

The examined operating envelope of the TIGO-R traction drive passenger lift platform, as certified under the European Lift Directive.

450to2000Rated load  ·  kg
26Capacity  ·  persons
4.0Rated speed  ·  m/s
200Travel  ·  m
2:1Suspension ratio
1128Notified body number
What the envelope means

One certified platform covers a residence and a high rise tower

A range from 450 kg to 2000 kg and travel to 200 m means the same examined platform can be specified for a private home lift or a tower serving fifty floors, without changing supplier or standard.

Figures are taken from the EU Type Examination Certificate for the TIGO-R platform. Final specification for any project is confirmed at design stage.

Since 2001, ALTIGO Elevator Sdn Bhd has been engineering seamless vertical mobility for Malaysia's most demanding built environments, from residential towers to high rise commercial hubs, delivering elevator and escalator solutions that move people safely, efficiently and with quiet confidence.

Certified by Malaysia's Department of Occupational Safety and Health, we hold ourselves to the highest standards. In partnership with Stade, a globally recognised leader in vertical transportation, ALTIGO brings world class innovation directly to the Malaysian market. Our team, trained locally and internationally, stays ahead of every technological and regulatory development.

We do not just install systems. We build long term partnerships grounded in reliability, precision and genuine care for every building and the people who use it.
